newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures close lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures close lower in thin trade.

text.p: UK wheat futures finished a thin session lower on Monday on a market seeking fresh direction.
"Most people thought the market was going to drop sharply mainly on currency, but in the end it didn't do a lot," said one trader.
Early losses of as much as one stg were soon wiped out as the market found support at the lower levels posting gains of around 0.10 stg in some positions during the afternoon.
However, by the close November 1996 was 0.55 stg down while positions in the New Year were 0.10 stg to 0.25 stg lower.
Turnover was low by comparison with some of last week's totals at 336 lots.
Barley futures closed unchanged after trading 70 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were unchanged and tradeless.
UK traders reported little activity on the cash markets.
"It's been a very poor day," one said.
